wrongUnits.problem: Implies every unmatched status-7 request will eventually be marked 12. The marking query also requires gen_sendtobankdate IS NOT NULL and datediff(day, LastThreeWorkingDays, gen_sendtobankdate) <= 0.
wrongUnits.correct: An unmatched status-7 request is not touched by the close step; it is moved to 12 only if gen_sendtobankdate is not null and is on/before the three-working-day threshold. A request with empty gen_sendtobankdate stays in status 7 with no record from this package.

wrongUnits.problem: 'בקשות שנפתח להן חשבון לקוח' (requests for which a customer account was opened) is not what the code tests. The Lookup matches ANY Gen_customeraccount with the same right-padded 12-char bank account number; there is no date, creation or request link, so a pre-existing account also closes the request.
wrongUnits.correct: Requests in status 7 for which a customer account with the same (right('0000000000000'+x,12)) bank account number exists in CRM are moved to 8 and linked to that account.
